posts.title: Announcing DECADE : OCTOBER 22ND : Dublin
posts.description: I realised recently I’ve been making movies for a decade. Ten years of short dramas, music videos, experimental documentaries, comedies and everything in between. The nature of filmmaking and festivals means that most of these films have never been publicly released, and some have never even had a screening. Well, no time like the present. […]
